summary.allegation: The cardholder says they cancelled their FluxFit Online subscription on 18 March 2025 but were still billed 29.99 GBP on 20 April 2025, and the issuer seeks reversal under Visa 13.2.
summary.to_defend: Visa requires the merchant to show the disclosed recurring terms and cancellation method, proof of the cardholder's original opt-in, evidence of the advance renewal notice, and a record that no cancellation request was received before the 20 April 2025 billing date.

requirements.title: Recurring terms disclosed
requirements.text: Terms of service disclosing the recurring billing arrangement and the cancellation method.
requirements.finding: The membership terms disclose monthly auto-renewal until cancelled and give two cancellation methods, the account dashboard or emailing support, in version terms_v3.2 published February 2025.

citations.quote: Subscriptions auto-renew monthly at the rate disclosed at signup until cancelled. Members may cancel at any time via their account dashboard or by emailing support@fluxfit.example.

requirements.title: Pre-charge notification sent
requirements.text: Evidence the cardholder was notified of the upcoming charge (typically 7 days in advance) for transactions over a defined threshold.
requirements.finding: The terms only promise that members will be emailed at least 5 days before renewal; no send record, copy or log of a renewal notice for the 20 April 2025 charge of 29.99 GBP was provided, and a policy statement is not proof the notice was sent.
requirements.gap: No copy of the pre-renewal email to this cardholder with a send timestamp or delivery log for the April 2025 renewal.

requirements.title: No cancellation before billing
requirements.text: No record of the cardholder having submitted a cancellation request prior to the billing date.
requirements.finding: Nothing in the file addresses the cardholder's stated cancellation of 18 March 2025; there is no account audit trail, support inbox search or system log showing no cancellation request was received before 20 April 2025.
requirements.gap: No subscription account log or support ticket record covering March to April 2025 for this cardholder.

requirements.title: Original opt-in
requirements.text: Evidence of the cardholder's original opt-in to the recurring arrangement.
requirements.finding: No signup or enrolment record for this cardholder was supplied: the only document is the generic published terms document that applies to all members, with no account identifier, date or consent capture. Authorisation data (AVS Y, CVV M, frictionless 3DS) supports the 20 April charge but does not evidence the original opt-in.
requirements.gap: No enrolment record showing the date, account and consent capture for the recurring arrangement.

alerts.text: The cardholder states they cancelled on 18 March 2025 and the merchant has filed nothing that answers that claim, no account log or support record for the cancellation window; confirm with the merchant before filing.
D1 promises renewal notice at least 5 days in advance, which is short of the 7 day advance notice contemplated by the 13.2 requirement; check which notice standard applies at this amount.

reasons: Evidence conflicts with the claim or the transaction data

checks.label: Key evidence comes from document text, not only from an image
Images the evidence relies on are fully legible
Every quoted passage was found in the documents
The disputed charge matches the merchant's own records
The rule check and the AI recommendation agree

justification: R3 and R4 decide this: without an account log showing no cancellation before 20 April 2025 and an opt-in record, the case cannot be filed, but the merchant could plausibly supply both.
rationale:
FluxFit Online's published terms disclose monthly auto-renewal and two cancellation routes, the account dashboard or support@fluxfit.example.
The cardholder was billed 29.99 GBP on 20 April 2025 on transaction txn_8856OP, authorised with a full AVS match, CVV match and frictionless 3DS.
The merchant has not yet produced the account record showing whether a cancellation was submitted on or around 18 March 2025.
No copy of the pre-renewal notice for the April 2025 billing and no original opt-in record have been supplied.
Additional merchant records are being obtained before a representment is filed.
merchant_requests: Subscription account audit log for this cardholder covering 1 March 2025 to 20 April 2025 showing all cancellation, pause and status change events
Search of support@fluxfit.example and the ticketing system for any message from this cardholder between 15 and 25 March 2025, including a nil result statement if none exists
Copy of the pre-renewal notification email sent before the 20 April 2025 charge, with the send or delivery log showing recipient address and timestamp
Original signup record for the recurring arrangement: date, account ID, terms version accepted and consent capture (checkbox or confirmation screen)
Billing history for this account confirming a single charge of 29.99 GBP on 20 April 2025 and no duplicate or subsequent charges
analyst_notes: D1 is the generic published terms document with no account identifier; ask for the version tied to this member's signup.
Confirm the dashboard cancellation flow logs an event even if the member does not complete it, so a nil log result is meaningful.
